coverage_questions: The paper does not provide the exact serialized prompt template, field delimiters, special tokens, or tokenizer details for GEMGen inputs.
The paper does not establish decoder teacher-forcing layout, target-response masking, or whether response tokens are included in the received sequence during fine-tuning.
The paper does not specify the internal autoregressive decoder computation used to generate SMILES responses.
The paper does not specify the exact ordering of cell-type context, up-regulated genes, and down-regulated genes in serialized prompts.
The paper does not specify how the scorer's response-token hidden state is exposed to the classification head.
The paper reports both a continuous scorer output and a separate binary classification-head output, but does not establish any conversion from the continuous score to the binary output.

The paper reports inconsistent novel-compound similarity criteria: the benchmark description states below 0.6, whereas the Methods section states below 0.8; the discrepancy is preserved as unresolved.

The paper does not specify the exact internal implementation of Characteristic Direction, E-distance, molecular similarity calculations, sign-based gene-set partitioning, syntactic-validity checking, deduplication, or checkpoint-output merging.
The paper does not specify whether Phase II generation examples reuse the Phase I prompt construction identically or whether any phase-specific serialization changes are made.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has ranking, selection, and normalization primitives, but no operation representing the multivariate Characteristic Direction calculation that compares perturbed and matched control transcriptomic groups and produces signed differential-expression statistics.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Sign-based partition of selected genes into up-regulated and down-regulated sets
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Ranking and selection represent the documented absolute-CD ordering and top-list selection. The catalog has no operation that assigns selected genes to directional sets according to the sign of their CD values.

The catalog contains attention, sampling, and learned projection primitives, but no operation representing a token-conditioned decoder-only autoregressive generation process with a documented SMILES response distribution.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Conversion of a continuous scorer output into a binary prediction
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents a separate classification-head binary output and a continuous scorer output, but does not document a score-to-label transformation. No catalog operation is used to assert such a relation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Molecular Tanimoto-similarity filtering for evaluation control replacement
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has selection and ranking, but no molecular-fingerprint similarity operation with a target-compound context port. The target phenotype compound set is context for the similarity calculation, not a selector.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Syntactic-validity filtering and deduplication of generated SMILES
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Selection can represent generic filtering, but the paper-specific chemical validity test and ordered deduplication computation are not represented by an existing documented primitive.
The paper says that outputs from three checkpoints are combined into an ensemble pool, but does not establish whether this is concatenation, set union, weighted pooling, or another operation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: L1000 perturbation grouping by metadata and same-plate replicate identity
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has selection and alignment, but no operation representing grouping samples by compound, cell type, time, dose, plate, and replicate identity.
